title: Create repo from fork, protect main, add templates
done_when: Private repo; main protected (or agreed team rule); PR template, CODEOWNERS, issue template merged; all 3 invited.

title: Agree and commit docs/conventions.md
done_when: Names for cluster, namespaces, repos, tables, buckets, region, tags agreed and merged.

title: Prepare each Learner Lab account (LabRole check, $10 budget alert)
done_when: Each member comments 'LabRole OK + budget set' on the issue; `aws iam get-role --role-name LabRole` succeeds.

title: Run GitHub bootstrap (labels, issues, project board)
done_when: Missions and sprint tracking issues exist; docs/status.md has the mapping.

title: Terraform bootstrap: state bucket + lock + backend config
done_when: `make bootstrap` is idempotent and creates shopops-tfstate-<account_id>; works in a second account.

title: Network module (VPC, 2 public subnets, IGW, routes)
done_when: VPC 10.0.0.0/16, 2 subnets in 2 AZs, IGW, EKS subnet tags, no NAT.

title: ECR module
done_when: retail-ui repository exists (force_delete true); URL is a terraform output.

title: EKS module (cluster, 2 t3.medium nodes, EBS CSI, hop limit 2)
done_when: `kubectl get nodes` shows 2 Ready; ebs-csi add-on ACTIVE; LabRole used for cluster and nodes.

title: Data module (DynamoDB carts + incidents, S3 incidents bucket)
done_when: Tables shopops-carts and shopops-incidents and the S3 bucket exist with agreed names.

title: make up / make down / cleanup script
done_when: Fresh account: `make up` -> ready. `make down` -> CLI check shows no EKS, no LB, no volumes, no EC2 left.

title: gp3 StorageClass + ingress-nginx
done_when: Test PVC binds on gp3; ingress-nginx exposes one load balancer.

title: Import upstream manifests into k8s/ (kustomize base)
done_when: 5 services Running in namespace retail, applied from k8s/ only.

title: Connect cart to DynamoDB
done_when: Cart item persists in shopops-carts and survives a cart pod restart.

title: Probes, requests/limits, UI exposed via ingress
done_when: Every deployment has liveness+readiness probes and resources; UI loads from the ingress URL.

title: End-to-end smoke test script
done_when: scripts/smoke_test.sh browses, adds to cart and checks out with all-200 responses.

title: Jenkins EC2 module (user-data, LabRole profile, Elastic IP)
done_when: Jenkins UI reachable; docker, trivy, kubectl, aws-cli installed; no static AWS keys.

title: Jenkinsfile: build, Trivy (fail on CRITICAL), push to ECR
done_when: Image lands in ECR; pipeline FAILS on a deliberately vulnerable base image. Temporary kubectl set image deploy stage allowed.

title: GitHub webhook trigger
done_when: A push to main starts a build automatically.

title: IaC scanning stage (tfsec or checkov)
done_when: Pipeline scans terraform/ and fails on HIGH findings (or documented exceptions).

title: Install ArgoCD and Application for k8s/
done_when: ArgoCD UI shows retail app Synced and Healthy; self-heal reverts a manual kubectl edit.

title: Jenkins commits image tag to Git (replace kubectl deploy)
done_when: UI change -> Jenkins -> Git commit -> ArgoCD -> new pod. Jenkins no longer uses kubectl. git revert rolls back.

title: kube-prometheus-stack with gp3 persistence
done_when: Prometheus + Grafana Running; PVCs Bound on gp3; data survives pod restart.

title: Grafana dashboards + CrashLoopBackOff PrometheusRule
done_when: Dashboard JSON exported to Git; a crashing test pod fires the alert.

title: CloudWatch CPU alarm -> SNS (Terraform module alerting)
done_when: Alarm and topic created by Terraform; set-alarm-state publishes to SNS.

title: Lambda: record incident in DynamoDB + JSON in S3
done_when: set-alarm-state creates one item in shopops-incidents and one object in S3.

title: Self-healing: Lambda scales node group (+1, max 3)
done_when: On alarm the node group grows once, action logged in incident record, scale-back documented.

title: CloudWatch vs Prometheus comparison write-up
done_when: docs/observability_comparison.md reviewed by another member.

title: metrics-server + HPA on ui (2-5) + k6 load test
done_when: k6 run scales ui above 2 replicas; Grafana screenshot saved.

title: Rolling update + rollback demonstration
done_when: Bad image is stopped by readiness probe; rollback via git revert documented with timings.

title: STRETCH: NetworkPolicies or chaos test
done_when: Optional. Policy blocks an unwanted flow, or pod-kill test shows HPA/alerts reacting.

title: Clean-room integration deploy in integration account
done_when: Fresh checkout + `make up` + pipeline run reproduces the whole stack; total time recorded.

title: Blameless post-mortem (1 page)
done_when: docs/postmortem.md based on a real incident from load/self-healing test.

title: README, architecture diagram, demo video (5-8 min)
done_when: Stranger can reproduce from README; video recorded.

title: Defense rehearsal and final destroy verification
done_when: Each member explains every layer; `make down` verified by CLI in every account.
